mu_name_from: MODEL_SAW, Data/Skill/Saw01.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:4196), not a placement: the Lance Trap throws it when it strikes (CreateEffect(MODEL_SAW), ZzzCharacter.cpp:1223-1227). Built here with the Dungeon's objects because the trap is drawn with them (game/world/trap_show.h), and named in tools/cook.py's TRAP_MODELS since nothing places it.
why_this_one: A flat toothed disc 38 units across, the Arquebus's blade's own shape. Born 1.3 m up at the trap, it flies 60 units a frame along the trap's facing, spinning 30 degrees a frame about its upright axis, for ten frames (ZzzEffect.cpp:1825-1830, MoveHandlers.cpp:2755-2758, MoveParticle).
sheet_from: Data/Skill/toothed_whee.OZJ (toothed_wheel cut at the name field's length), decoded under the dn_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: painted_steel: MU's metal as MU drew it, a painted blade with no reflectance of its own; the cyan on each tooth is paint. CreateEffect leaves it BlendMesh -1, solid.
